g.text: The inference from A₁, …, Aₙ to B is valid iff every valuation
making all premises true makes B true: [A₁] ∩ … ∩ [Aₙ] ⊆ [B].
{ M₁, M₂, M₃ } ∩ { M₃, M₄ } = { M₃ } ⊆ [RAIN]
I left the key at home or it's in my backpack.
The key is not in my backpack
I left the key at home.
Only M₃ survives both premises, and RAIN is true there.
No countermodel, so the inference is valid.
